newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis hits record as Lithuania bourse advances.
newsitem.headline: Hermis hits record as Lithuania bourse advances.

text.p: Hermis Bank hit an all-time high while shares in rival Vilniaus Bank rose to their previous best level as stocks advanced on the Lithuanian bourse by the close on Friday.
The official list index rose 17.48 points to 1017.71 while the broader group-A index gained 12.26 points to 1847.04.
But central market turnover sagged to 754,000 litas from over a million litas the day before.
Hermis shares set a new high, jumping to 250.20 litas from 241.50 litas.
Brokers said that Vilniaus Bank, advancing to its previous record of 260 litas from 253 litas, pulled its rival up.
"Vilniaus Bank is so high that everybody thinks Hermis bank should be the same," one broker said.
Hermis turned over 330,000 litas in block trades at prices ranging from 240 to 250 litas. Vilniaus Bank saw 132,000 litas of block trades at 240 to 265 litas.

Brokers say the price of Hermis on the central market will level off for the time being but that Vilniaus Bank will continue to be buoyed by its first-half results and a low supply of shares on the domestic market.
"It could go up to 300 litas," one dealer said. "There are simply no shares in Lithuania."
Rokishkis Cheese, one of three corporates on the official list, advanced to 45 litas from 44.50 litas in central market turnover of 157,000 litas.
Brokers say they were impressed with Rokishkis's first half results but that large block deals at low prices are keeping it cheap on the central market.
Rokishkis turned over 439,000 litas in block trades at prices ranging from 44.50 to 44.70 litas.
